steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: ...It's me.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: You were right. The cop chose to help the Pioneers. And Elena Urbica turned on Director Clooney.
A sigh leaks out of the communicator.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: What a shame.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ferdinand has lost.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Why do you say that? Sure, I couldn't stop them, but there aren't too many.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: I just happened to see your old boss returning to Rhine Lab headquarters.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Director Saria?!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Settle down. You've taken quite a beating, yes? From whom? The cop? I believe you said she's like Saria in some ways?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: There's nobody quite like her.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: I... I just don't understand.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Why would she do that? All the hard work she put in... Rhine Lab meant more to her than health or fame.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: I wanted to follow in her footsteps and defend Rhine. Why would she betray us?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Did she...? Or did we let her down?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: What do you—

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ah, the follies of youth.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: The young seek out those they think are of like mind, but true understanding only comes with time.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: They may argue incessantly now, but there was a time when they treated each other with sincerity, more or less.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Director Parvis... do I hear music?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ah, have you not heard this tune before?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Oh, that's right, you joined after Rhine Lab's first New Year's party.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: We didn't have our own building back then.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Kristen rented half the floor of an office building next to the Trimounts Institute of Technology, and shared an old apartment with Saria nearby.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Ferdinand talked about bringing in funding for us, but once he left his old job, his former associates stopped answering his mail.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: I was still at my old lab, and only went back to Trimounts a couple of times per month.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: On New Year's Eve, I got a message from Muelsyse ordering me to attend the party.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: It snowed heavily that night, and the roads back from Max D.C. were packed. I didn't want to go to all that effort, but Muelsyse didn't give me a choice.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: She said she would soak my pillow in icy water if I didn't get back on time.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: I stepped into the office, just before the clock struck twelve.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Then I heard the song.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: It was a dreadful song.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: As a Leithanian, I have never understood, to this day, how Muelsyse, an authority on Originium Arts, could have such vulgar taste in music.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: But the others didn't seem bothered. Ferdinand asked Saria to dance with him, and she said yes. Could you believe it?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: As for Kristen... she watched from the sides. That night, she spent more time looking at the people in the room than outside the window.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Those days... I can hardly remember them now.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: How did that song go?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: I suppose I really am getting old.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Director Parvis?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Are... are you asleep?
There is no response from the communicator.
The tune keeps playing, looping over and over again.
He does not know if the old Caprinae is still sitting by the communicator.

All he knows is that when he returns to Rhine Lab headquarters at dawn, he will see Parvis standing at his usual spot, a teacup in his hands, watching young faces come and go below with a smile on his face.
